title: Rogue Textures
description: a simple Resource Pack for blocks, items and mobs.
body:
# roguetextures

### ✨ Features
- Resource Pack for Block, Entity and Item textures
- Style is simple and colorful

### 🛠️ Installation
1. Download a version of the Resource Pack
2. Place the Resource Pack in the Minecraft resourcepacks folder
3. Activate the Resource Pack in Minecraft

### 📂 Other Resource Packs
